# Getting help

Thanks for using **ferrixd**. Here's the fastest route to an answer, depending
on what you need.

## 📖 Read the docs first

Most questions are answered in the documentation:

- **[Documentation home](https://josunlp.github.io/ferrixd/)**
- [Quick Start](https://josunlp.github.io/ferrixd/guide/quick-start) ·
  [Installation](https://josunlp.github.io/ferrixd/guide/installation) ·
  [Configuration](https://josunlp.github.io/ferrixd/guide/configuration)
- [Federation (S2S)](https://josunlp.github.io/ferrixd/guide/federation) ·
  [Operators & Moderation](https://josunlp.github.io/ferrixd/guide/operators) ·
  [WASM Plugins](https://josunlp.github.io/ferrixd/guide/plugins)
- [CLI Reference](https://josunlp.github.io/ferrixd/reference/cli) — or run
  `ferrixd --help` / `ferrixd <command> --help`
- [`ferrixd.example.toml`](https://github.com/josunlp/ferrixd/blob/main/ferrixd.example.toml)
  documents every configuration knob.

Before asking, `ferrixd check` validates your config **and** its TLS material and
prints exactly what it will start — it catches most deployment problems on its own.

## 💬 Questions & discussion

For usage questions, deployment help, "is this the right way to…?", and design
ideas, use **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/josunlp/ferrixd/discussions)**.
It's searchable, and answers help the next person with the same question.

## 🐛 Bugs & feature requests

If you've found a reproducible bug or want to propose a change, open an
**[issue](https://github.com/josunlp/ferrixd/issues/new/choose)** using the
appropriate template. A crash, a protocol violation, or behaviour that
contradicts the docs is a bug; a usage question is not — that goes to Discussions.

## 🔐 Security

**Do not report security vulnerabilities through public issues, discussions, or
pull requests.** Use GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/josunlp/ferrixd/security/advisories/new)
and see **[SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md)** for scope and expectations.

## 🤝 Contributing

Want to fix or build something yourself? See
**[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)** for the ground rules (they're enforced
by CI) and how to get set up.
